text: We arrived an hour before closing for our toddler yet were seen to very promptly by a kind and gentle doctor and were charged 200B for our consultation. Were relieved to have been referred to them by the local pharmacy, as it can be unnerving using medical services when you’re overseas, but they were friendly and professional.
Fast service. Very nice folks working here.
The doctor is kind, polite, and lovely, and has been taking care of the children since they were little until they grew up.

I went to get a chickenpox shot. I called the day before and again on the day of my appointment. They didn't inform me that they were out of medication. I waited for an hour. When it was my turn, the doctor said, "You can't get the shot today. We're out of medication. You can get it elsewhere." Why did they make me wait then? Didn't they check if they had enough supplies when I admitted the patient? It was a huge waste of time. This was my first and last time here. I feel terrible. Please improve this process.
